checks.finding: The nine coordinates are canonical arithmetic data of the actual full original q,r,N1,N2. The Valid structure contains only positive natural coordinates, exact factorizations, gcd identities, prime support and coprimality. The constructor proves all fields for positive original tuples without analytic inputs.

Actual row membership and MediumAdmissible pay full q,r and original beta-integer positivity. Existing ComplexCRT.Compatible pays N1/N2 coprime to D and the exact phase gates (k1*k2) coprime D, (n1*k1*k2) coprime Dprime, k1 coprime(n1*k2), n2 coprime(n1*k2). No caller factor or phase dictionary replaces the original labels.

For the actual product CRT residue b and signed a, the exact circle b/lcm(q,r) is decomposed using lcm=D*k1*k2 and Dprime=d*d1*D. The three congruences are combined only with proved coprime factors; positive denominator gates are paid, including modulus one.

Root phase retains +b*inv(k1*k2,D)/D - a*inv(n1*k1*k2,Dprime)/Dprime. Slow phase retains +a/(n1*k1*k2*Dprime). Reciprocal phase retains +a*(d1*n1-n2)*inv(Dprime*n2*k1,n1*k2)/(n1*k2). Original residue a is signed Int and b is the existing constructed CRT representative, also Int.

The actual CommonPoisson positive character fourier h(b/L) is factored with exactly the same signed h:Int into all three phases. Negative and zero h are included, no h->-h reindex or extra conjugation is introduced. The zero cutoff remains exactly if h=0 then 0.

The Fourier coefficient stays (U/L)*Fourier(chi)((U/L)*h) at the full physical lcm L. The whole exact nonzero sum and actual energy retain original complex beta/gamma coefficients and star, Compatible gates, common U/carrier/weight, raw zero mode and primitive -2V+U.
